summary: Add clock-driven live activity labels, accessible long-message disclosure, circular composer actions, a compact composer dock, lighter light-theme borders, and antialiased root text. Composer shapes remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Long operator messages initially show at most eight lines and 600 characters within a 176px total disclosure budget. Hosts supply the existing Transcript now clock for live elapsed labels. Shared composer Send is a labelled 32px circle and history is a 28px ghost action. Restored drafts initialize runtime text before paint so placeholder guidance and send availability agree with the controlled field.
